sections.text_helper: Section 35.8 "MDF registers" in chapter 35 (Multi-function digital filter (MDF)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1684.
sections.section_content:
All the MDF registers must be accessed either in word (32-bit) or half-word (16-bit) formats.
The registers are described for the MDF instance having the biggest number of filters.
Forregisters related to filters, the number of registers is equal to the amount of filters. Refer
to Section35.3 for details.
